findings.message: YARA rule 'backdoor_persistence': Backdoor persistence with malicious payloads (shell commands, SSH key injection, hidden root users) [malware]

suppressed.reason: A SKILL.md with no allowed-tools, on line 1 of nearly every upstream skill. It says the author did not declare tools, which this set cannot change, not that a tool is misused.

One finding per reference_missing exception. Sampled across the recorded audits, those are version strings (version: "1.0.0"), dotted ids, example and runtime paths, and sibling skills named as other-skill/SKILL.md; the rare real broken link is not a security finding. The exceptions stay listed.
